capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Peer review of Source Code changes before merge.

items.statement: Check if common services can be made
Create a common component if it can be reused in an app. Create single responsibility components
Create a separate folder for routes for a specific page and import all components and map them with the routes.
State and UI should be maintained separately.
The project should have a Readme file with instructions how to run locally and other useful info
Minimize logic in the render method. Logic should be in helper methods, container components or in Redux actions (if used)
Use functional components for components that don’t use state
Make sure you don’t edit props within a component
Use code formatting such as beautify and prettier for indenting the codes
Remove unwanted variables and method that are not in use.
Remove unwanted packages that are not in use from package.json
Every useEffect and function should have proper commenting
There should be consistency in the import statement used in the files
Need to have baseUrl set for import
Avoid using var, and promote use of let and const.
There should be 0 warnings while compiling the code
Make sure that sensitive data are saved on .env files and are used from that on projects.
Avoid unnecessary use of redux
Merge common styling by providing the common classnames
Prevent unwanted re-rendering of components
Create utils for performing common action through the project
Use constant file in a component to get the static content
Use arrow functions to create methods instead of binding in constructors.
While using keys for dynamic lists check if keys are unique index should be fine if the list items will not change order. Preferred way is to use primary keys generated from db.
Try avoiding multiple setState in a single function and be mindful of the asynchronous nature of setStates.
When changing state in setState based on previous state value use previous state.
Sync and npm-check to automate the task of identifying insecure and outdated components.
Use Redux for global state management
Make sure to use functional components for components that don’t use state
Don’t use mixins, prefer HOC and composition
Avoid using inline styles, rather use themes or styled components
Avoid to useEffect without dependencies - Can loop infinitely
Use Memoization to reduce load on App / Server
Apply Lazy-Loading where its required to optimize bundle load
Avoid direct DOM access
Avoid JSON injection attacks
All the paths private information should be a part of env file to avoid exposing
Minimize logic in the render method. Logic should be in helper methods, container components or in Redux actions (if used)
